propositions: Return type annotations are omitted from public API surface snapshots despite being part of the documented stable contract
Current class method serialization produces bare parameter lists without return type information, requiring baseline shape migration to include return descriptors

A return-normalization helper must handle Signature.empty (null), actual None annotations ("None" string), postponed string annotations (preserved verbatim), and live type objects (formatted via inspect.formatannotation) consistently across Python versions
Public class methods already captured by _describe_class must be migrated from parameter-list form to {"params": [...], "return": <value>} descriptor form with identical parameter data

Return-only contract changes currently pass validation undetected because baseline entries lack return fields; held-out tests must verify drift detection for both top-level callables and captured class methods
